patches.label: age_groups_parser
edits: cast(trim(both '"' from replace(list_extract(regexp_extract_all(record, '(^|,)("(?:[^"]|"")*"|\[[^\]]*\]|[^,]*)', 2), 64), '""', '"')) as VARCHAR) as age_groups
patches.reason: agent正确保留quoted array完整字段，gold简单按逗号分割截断；以header和CSV诊断为证。

patches.label: invalid_prefix
edits:
CASE
        WHEN TRY_CAST(NULLIF(regexp_replace(coalesce(journal_number, ''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '') AS BIGINT) <= 9999999
            THEN TRY_CAST(NULLIF(regexp_replace(coalesce(journal_number, ''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '') AS INTEGER)
        ELSE NULL
    END

CASE WHEN journal_number LIKE 'INVALID%' OR journal_number LIKE 'BAD%' THEN NULL ELSE CASE
        WHEN TRY_CAST(NULLIF(regexp_replace(coalesce(journal_number, ''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '') AS BIGINT) <= 9999999
            THEN TRY_CAST(NULLIF(regexp_replace(coalesce(journal_number, ''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '') AS INTEGER)
        ELSE NULL
    END END
patches.reason: 契约要求移除字母/特殊字符后保留有效数字，gold额外将INVALID/BAD前缀置NULL。
